# 0120. Imprimatur follows Matt Pocock's skills system: his names and artifacts; Imprimatur is the backend…

## Context and Problem Statement

Task #179: Epic: Imprimatur moves to Matt Pocock's skills system (spec, wayfinder map, tickets, GLOSSARY.md, ADRs).

## Considered Options

The options are not listed apart; the decision below says what was chosen and why.

## Decision Outcome

Imprimatur follows Matt Pocock's skills system: his names and artifacts; Imprimatur is the backend of his local tracker, not a task manager

The user, 2026-11-10: rewrite the analysis process and the documents from scratch the way mattpocock/skills (4ae2317ddb22) does it, with his names.

- Artifacts: spec (to-spec), wayfinder map with research/prototype/grilling/task tickets, tracer-bullet tickets (to-tickets), GLOSSARY.md, docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md, .out-of-scope/<concept>.md, docs/agents/{issue-tracker,domain,triage-labels}.md.
- Where they live: Pocock's local-markdown tracker layout (.scratch/<feature>/spec.md, issues/NN-slug.md, .scratch/<effort>/map.md), backed by Imprimatur so the agent can work where Jira (Boston Scientific) or GitHub is out of reach. The user: "Imprimatur is not a task management tool; that was never the aim."
- Names exactly Pocock's; "analysis" goes everywhere.
- Old task analyses are deleted, specs written fresh.
- Architecture and Product documents have no equivalent in Pocock: their lasting knowledge goes to ADRs (architectural shape, integrations, lock-in, boundaries, invisible constraints), GLOSSARY.md and .out-of-scope/; product intent lives in each spec (Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories); PDR goes.
- Market/product research: option (b), wayfinder + research tickets; no market-research skill carried.
- Competitor and OSS research first (#180); not started yet at the user's request.
